```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(comment = "#>", collapse = TRUE)
library(agreeR)
```

## Overview

`agreeR` provides a reproducible workflow for agreement analysis in
method comparison studies with a single measurement per participant per
method:

- `ba_loa()`: Bland-Altman mean bias and limits of agreement
- `olp()`: ordinary least products (OLP) regression
- `equiv_test()`: equivalence testing via the two one-sided tests (TOST)
  procedure

All three functions return a tibble of point estimates with bootstrap
confidence intervals (BCa by default; `ci_type = "perc"` for percentile
intervals).

## Example data

We simulate paired measurements from a reference device and a comparison
method:

```{r data}
set.seed(123)
n <- 40
sim <- rnorm(n, mean = 100, sd = 10)
dat <- data.frame(
  reference = sim + rnorm(n, 2, 1),
  comparison = sim + rnorm(n, 5, 3)
)
head(dat)
```

## Limits of agreement

```{r ba}
set.seed(123)
ba_loa(dat, reference = "reference", comparison = "comparison")
```

## Ordinary least products regression

The OLP slope is the ratio of the standard deviations of the two methods,
`b = s_y / s_x` (Ludbrook, 2012), with the intercept chosen so the
line passes through the point of means.

```{r olp}
set.seed(123)
olp(dat, reference = "reference", comparison = "comparison")
```

## Equivalence testing

Equivalence is declared when the bootstrap confidence interval for the mean
difference lies entirely within pre-specified equivalence bounds. A 90%
interval (the default `conf = 0.90`) corresponds to 5% type I error per
one-sided test.

```{r equiv}
set.seed(123)
equiv_test(
  dat,
  reference = "reference",
  comparison = "comparison",
  lower = -5,
  upper = 5
)
```

## References

- Bland, J. M., & Altman, D. G. (1986). Statistical methods for assessing
  agreement between two methods of clinical measurement. *Lancet*, *327*(8476),
  307-310.
- Ludbrook, J. (2012). A primer for biomedical scientists on how to execute
  Model II linear regression analysis. *Clinical and Experimental Pharmacology
  and Physiology*, *39*(4), 329-335.
- Dixon, P. M., Saint-Maurice, P. F., Kim, Y., Hibbing, P., Bai, Y., & Welk, G. J.
  (2018). A primer on the use of equivalence testing for evaluating measurement
  agreement. *Medicine and Science in Sports and Exercise*, *50*(4), 837-845.
